profiles.label: Stores
profiles.area_defined: All buildings where consumers purchase goods or services.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during customer shopping and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible reduced staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for stores, shops, grocery stores, supermarkets, malls, and retail buildings. Good evidence includes shoppers, customers, visitors, employees, or staff inside, evacuated, rescued, counted during an inspection, or attending a bounded store event. Treat store capacity, directory listings, annual visitors, and sales volume as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official fire or code enforcement report

profiles.label: Public markets
profiles.area_defined: All buildings and areas used by stalls, tents, or open stores selling goods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible reduced staff, maintenance, janitorial, or security presence.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for public markets, farmers markets, goods markets, covered markets, wet markets, and market halls. Good evidence includes vendors, customers, shoppers, visitors, or employees inside, evacuated, rescued, counted during an inspection, or present during a bounded market event. Treat stall counts and market capacity as context only.

profiles.label: Kiosks and food trucks
profiles.area_defined: The kiosk, stand, food truck, and immediate area where employees and customers are present.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during vending and customer service periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Usually closed, with possible reduced staff.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for kiosks, stands, carts, booths, and food trucks. Good evidence includes employees, vendors, customers, or patrons present, injured in a way that confirms presence, evacuated, rescued, or counted during an inspection. Treat permits, capacity, and generic listings as context only.
preferred_source_types: official health or code inspection report

profiles.label: Hotels and motels
profiles.area_defined: Only rooms and suites unless the source explicitly ties the count to another hotel area.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open with guests, employees, visitors, and service staff.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open with guests and reduced employees.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for hotels, motels, inns, lodges, and lodging properties. Good evidence includes guests, occupants, employees, staff, or visitors inside, evacuated, rescued, displaced, sheltered, or counted during a bounded incident or official action. Treat room count, occupancy rate, and booking pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report

profiles.label: Filling stations
profiles.area_defined: All buildings and outdoor fueling areas where customers fuel vehicles.
profiles.day_occurrence: Open during fuel sales, retail, and staff work periods.
profiles.night_occurrence: Open or closed depending on facility, with reduced staff and some visitors.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find count-bearing reports for filling stations, gas stations, petrol stations, service stations, and fuel stops. Good evidence includes customers, visitors, employees, or staff present, inside, evacuated, rescued, or counted during an incident or official action. Treat pump counts and fuel capacity as context only.
preferred_source_types: official environmental or safety incident report
positive_evidence_patterns: people were at the gas station
